isolation.statement: The draft inventory was reviewed independently against only the allowed v2.6 specifications, validators, source chain, gate manifest, and complete transcript; no annotation pass or lock was available.

findings.description: The Williamson allegation was not the immediate opponent claim because Hitchens advanced several distinct claims afterward; the response explicitly returned to the earlier allegation.
The humanitarian central bridge did not describe a reply about papal discipline and institutional protection; the motion-level bridge is the eligible route connection.
The historical comparison rule answered Hitchens's catalogue of admitted historical wrongs, not his later non-relativization claim about institutional child abuse.
The Mormon missionary analogy continued the immediately preceding reply to Widdecombe's aid counterfactual, rather than targeting her separate membership-and-hierarchy claim.
The sampled excerpt began after Fry's actual limbo response and instead captured a broader criticism of the Church's representatives, so it did not faithfully instantiate the locked reply.
Widdecombe's autobiographical statement that she attended Catholic school was not indispensable to her theological correction and was removed from the target graph.
Hitchens advanced moral-chaos, invented-gods, and repentance claims after the slavery argument, making Onaiyekan's scope reply an explicit return to an earlier load-bearing claim.

The selected act specifically disputes Fry's earlier condom-efficacy argument; the draft instead locked Hitchens's broader reproductive-control and mortality claim and omitted the act's operative empirical denial.
The repaired inventory retains twelve chronological acts, balanced six per side, one constructive and two responsive acts for each of all four named speakers.
All twelve acts occur within chair-announced continuous turns and preserve ownership across Onaiyekan, Widdecombe, Fry, and Hitchens with no mixed-speaker excerpts.
After repair, every responsive packet contains nonduplicative indispensable propositions with node-specific kinds and no stylistic paraphrase duplication within a packet.
Each retained excerpt expresses one bounded argumentative act; the repaired Fry and Onaiyekan excerpts now contain the operative reply rather than adjacent argumentative material.

repairs.change: Reclassified target 173-t03 as an earlier load-bearing claim and added the required intervening-claim rationale.
Replaced pro-central-humanitarian with pro-motion-net-good and revised the bridge-selection rationale.
Rebuilt target 173-t04 from Hitchens's exact historical-wrongs excerpt with a matching two-node component graph and earlier-target rationale.
Retargeted 173-t08 to Widdecombe's aid counterfactual and rebuilt its three components to match the charity inference tested by the Mormon analogy.
Replaced move 173-m10's excerpt, span, timestamp, hash, and selection rationale with Fry's exact limbo-authority reply.
Removed the nonindispensable autobiographical component from 173-t10 and renumbered the remaining premise-conclusion dependency graph.
Reclassified target 173-t11 as an earlier load-bearing claim and documented the intervening opponent claims.
Retargeted 173-t12 to Fry, rebuilt its condom-efficacy packet, and replaced the sampled move excerpt with Onaiyekan's exact population-level empirical denial.

thirdReviewTrigger.rationale: Repairs changed target recency, burden bridge eligibility, target packets, component structure, and the meaning-bearing excerpts for responsive acts, so a fresh third review is mandatory.
